why_threshold_crossed_now: CoinGecko's Bittensor Subnets category reached roughly $1.22B and was up about 14.1% over 24h, showing breadth rather than a TAO-only spike.
TAO was roughly $266-$271, up about 13.8%-14.4% over 24h, with roughly $466M-$493M 24h volume; CoinGecko historical data shows current-day volume more than doubled versus Sep 6's ~$167M.
Large subnets with identifiable commercial activity participated: Lium SN51 was about +13.5% with ~$109.6M market cap and ~$2.18M volume; Chutes SN64 was about +12% with ~$117M market cap.

Chainlink's official CCIP directory confirms canonical TAO is now listed on Bittensor EVM, Base and Robinhood Chain, and the Robinhood-Bittensor mainnet CCIP lane is operational. This gives the AI ecosystem a new route into the highest-velocity speculative chain currently being tracked.
The wider AI category was also positive, roughly +4.5% over 24h in one current CoinGecko snapshot, while Bittensor subnets substantially outperformed it.

evidence: Lium and Chutes both +~12%-14%, indicating internal ecosystem breadth.
Canonical TAO cross-chain availability on Robinhood Chain is verified by Chainlink rather than inferred from same-symbol community tokens.

why_flows_appear_speculative.classification: discretionary narrative rotation with real utility backdrop, not a new farming campaign
positive_evidence: TAO has no TGE airdrop history, no premine, no ICO, and no current launch incentive campaign driving this move.
Price and volume acceleration is occurring across TAO and multiple subnets, while the broader crypto market is comparatively flatter.
The new Robinhood Chain distribution path and decentralized-AI narrative provide concrete catalysts.
discounts: Bittensor still emits roughly 3,600 TAO/day after its first halving; underlying subnet economics remain materially emission-supported.
Independent estimates put externally verified subnet revenue around $28M-$35M annualized across 24 subnets, materially below network-wide token emissions at current TAO prices.
Therefore this is lower-quality economic confirmation than HYPE/UNI-style direct fee capture even though the current trading rotation itself is not being paid for by a new points/airdrop program.

leadership_rank.reason: deepest executable liquidity, strongest ecosystem-wide reserve/staking role, broad price-volume confirmation, and canonical cross-chain expansion

~+13.5% 24h and strongest reported external subnet revenue ($8M-$10M annualized) with customer-funded alpha acquisition/burn; not surfaced as a standalone alert because liquidity and wallet concentration are insufficiently audited
~+12% 24h, ~$117M market cap and identifiable commercial AI usage; not surfaced because onchain executable liquidity and holder-independence evidence remain too thin

evidence: TAO is the network-wide reserve, settlement and staking asset for subnet markets.
Bittensor's Root Reborn design gives root-staked TAO claims on subnet alpha dividend baskets; official Bittensor material reported roughly 936 TAO/day of root dividend flow at a July checkpoint.
Native transaction/EVM fees reduce or recycle TAO issuance, while subnet activity creates demand for TAO-backed liquidity pools.
Some commercially active subnets use external customer revenue to buy/burn their alpha tokens, strengthening the underlying ecosystem but not creating a direct pro-rata cash claim for unstaked TAO.
value_capture.caveat: A large part of network economics remains inflationary rather than customer-funded. TAO value capture is productive staking/reserve demand, not a direct immutable revenue distribution to every liquid token holder.

notes: No independently funded cohort of historically selective TAO wallets was verified in this run.
Small reported exchange-outflow anecdotes were not given smart-money credit.
TaoWeave's previously disclosed H1 sale of 3,959 TAO is a modest treasury-supply overhang and is retained as a negative caveat rather than treated as current marginal distribution.

social_and_news.classification: broad ecosystem attention, not single-influencer driven
evidence: CoinGecko shows category-wide Bittensor subnet breadth and multiple subnet leaders.
Independent current market coverage is discussing TAO together with ICP/AI-infrastructure rotation rather than a single KOL promotion.
No sudden concentrated influencer campaign was identified as the dominant cause of the move.

liquidity_and_executability.evidence: roughly $466M-$493M 24h global token turnover and broad centralized-exchange availability
liquidity_and_executability.local_evidence: one indexed Robinhood Chain snapshot showed about $189K liquidity against about $3.14M 24h local volume and only a few hundred holders; this local representation should not be mistaken for globally deep TAO liquidity

positive: TAO was fair launched with no premine, ICO, insider allocation, vesting or scheduled unlocks.
Native supply is capped at 21M and current issuance is protocol-defined at about 3,600 TAO/day.
No creator-controlled LP, honeypot, freeze authority or microcap deployer rug surface exists for native TAO.
Blockworks transparency filing reports no project-controlled treasury allocation available for market-maker or exchange token loans.
caveats: Canonical TAO on Robinhood Chain is a Chainlink CCT burn/mint representation, so its mint authority is intentionally delegated to the CCIP token-pool mechanism rather than being absent.
Cross-chain users inherit CCIP/token-pool security risk.
Ongoing emissions are meaningful dilution even though there are no discretionary team unlocks.
Selective-wallet independence and native holder concentration were not fully reconstructed in this run.

major_uncertainties: How much of the move is persistent AI-capital rotation versus a one-day narrative burst.
Whether Robinhood Chain availability produces durable TAO holders/liquidity; local CCT liquidity is still thin.
Whether external customer revenue across subnets can grow fast enough relative to TAO emissions to improve economic quality.
Whether subnet breadth persists after TAO momentum cools rather than simply reflecting reflexive TAO-backed AMM repricing.
why_signal_matters_now: This is the first newly qualified non-meme ecosystem rotation in the current scan where the flagship and economically active subnets are accelerating together. It creates a prospective test of whether real commercial AI activity plus new cross-chain distribution can sustain speculative leadership even when the underlying token economy is still materially emission-supported.
